newsitem.title: USA: Essef Corp sees some benefit from merger.
newsitem.headline: Essef Corp sees some benefit from merger.

text.p: Essef Corp said on Tuesday that its $68 million acquisition of General Aquatics Inc is expected to aid its fiscal 1997 earnings by $0.35 to $0.45 a share.
The company said the projection could be affected by accounting complexities and the weather.
Essef said the projection accounts for integration costs and full year interest costs and amortization of goodwill.
Essef said it anticipates a similar effect on fiscal 1998 results before any benefits from the combination of General Aquatics and Essef.
In fiscal 1996 ended September 30, the company reported $200.9 million in net sales and net income of $9.3 million, or $1.56 a share.
